name: Southern Maple Co
old_description: Mark has been studying and practicing the art of furniture making for 8 years. His work can be seen from CA to NY, as well as in businesses including the Omni Hotel and Able in Nashville, where he’s lived since 2009.
about:
Southern Maple Co operates from Nashville, Tennessee, where owner Randy Cuba established the business after relocating from his home state in 2015. Cuba's woodworking roots trace back to childhood projects with his father, whose tools he inherited and which sparked a deeper commitment to the craft. After honing his skills at the Fort Houston maker space, Cuba launched Southern Maple Co as a custom woodworking shop focused on furniture and cabinetry.

The company designs and builds heirloom-quality furniture and cabinets for residential and commercial clients. Work is performed in a Nashville shop where the team — including furniture maker Mark Shreve, who has eight years of experience and a portfolio that spans coast-to-coast installations — handles projects from concept through installation. Shreve's background includes pieces for the Omni Hotel and the Nashville venue Able, indicating a capacity for both one-off commissions and larger hospitality builds.

Clients range from homeowners seeking bespoke tables, bookcases, and built-ins to businesses needing custom millwork for hotels and restaurants. The firm emphasizes a collaborative process, keeping the client involved from initial design to final delivery. Past work includes sofa tables, bookcases, pallet walls, and hospitality furniture for venues in the Nashville area.

Cuba frames the business around translating a client's vision into a lasting piece, citing the personal satisfaction of bringing ideas to life as the core motivation. The shop's differentiator is presented as a hands-on, client-integrated workflow rather than volume production.
